confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are triangulated from a few aggregated 2026 sources (Numbeo June 2026 figures, a cost-of-living guide, and aperitivo-style price ranges), so restaurant anchors are moderately reliable, and beer, cocktail and wine are less certain. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July high-season window, not based on inspected booking pages or current listings. EUR is converted to USD at an assumed rate of about 1.10, which I did not verify directly. The FX observation (0.6720 USD per AUD, 18 Nov 2026) was taken from a search snippet of the RBA exchange-rates page, not from opening the full table, and no 19 Nov observation was confirmed. Cocktail and wine estimates are cross-checked against typical beer-to-drink price relationships in Rome.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored on Rome's own published 2026 food and drink price ranges. Accommodation is benchmarked against other major Italian tourist cities (such as Florence and Milan) in peak summer, with a holistic adjustment for Rome's high-season demand.
